claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic final features Venezuela vs. Team USA.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final is on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final is at loanDepot Park in Miami, FL.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final will be broadcast on FOX, Tubi, and Fubo.
Starting pitchers for the 2026 World Baseball Classic final are Nolan McLean for USA and Eduardo Rodriguez for Venezuela.
Venezuela reached its first WBC final by defeating Italy.
Venezuela defeated Italy 4-2 in the semifinals.
Venezuela's semifinal win was led by key hits from Maikel Garcia and Luis Arraez.
Team USA reached their third straight final.
Team USA beat the Dominican Republic 2-1 in the semifinals on Sunday.
Gunnar Henderson and Roman Anthony hit homers in Team USA's semifinal.
The U.S. beat Venezuela 9-7 in the 2023 World Baseball Classic quarterfinals.
Venezuela's lineup features Ronald Acuña and Luis Arraez.
USA's lineup features Aaron Judge and Bryce Harper
